tasks.final_text: My favorite food is honey walnut shrimp. I started making this when starting classes as a graduate student living in graduate housing. I have my own kitchen, and no meal plan. I was perusing through the ailes of Trader Joes and stumbled upon this Honey Walnut Shrimp package in the frozen aisle. I decided to try it out since I love the Honey Walnut Shrimp from Panda Express, and OMG it is sooo good.

The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.
